label: prf:plancherel-weight-boundedness
title: Proof of plancherel weight boundedness
html:
Proof. The classical Plancherel identity for the symmetric-group regular representation, lifted to the Hecke algebra via the Wedderburn--Artin decomposition (Wedderburn trace):

  \dim_\mathbb{Q} A \;=\; n!
  \;=\; \sum_{\lambda \,\vdash\, n} (\dim V_\lambda)^2.

(The Hecke irrep dimensions \dim V_\lambda are q-independent for generic q — they coincide with the symmetric-group irrep dimensions f_\lambda.) Dividing by n! proves (2). Each summand is a non-negative ratio bounded by the total sum, proving (1). \square

Corollary (convergence of curvature-rank functionals). The strata-sum \mathfrak{m}^{(k)}_{q,\mathcal{K}}(\mathcal{T}) = \sum_{\lambda \in \Lambda_k} w_\lambda \cdot \log\bigl|\!\int_{A_\lambda}\!\rho(\beta_\mathcal{K}) \cdot \mathcal{T}\bigr| of the unified mass formula (unified mass formula) is bounded by \sup_{\lambda \in \Lambda_k} \bigl|\log \bigl|\!\int_{A_\lambda}\!\cdot\bigr|\bigr| \cdot \sum_{\lambda \in \Lambda_k} w_\lambda \leq \sup |\log|\!\int|\!|, since \sum_{\lambda \in \Lambda_k} w_\lambda \leq \sum_\lambda w_\lambda = 1.

The total mass functional \mathfrak{m}_{q,\mathcal{K}}(\mathcal{T}) = \sum_k \alpha_k \mathfrak{m}^{(k)}_{q,\mathcal{K}}(\mathcal{T}) is therefore absolutely convergent for any bounded |\alpha_k|, with no super-exponential divergence at large n.

Plancherel distribution at q_0 = 1.109978595642739\ldots (muon pin, 16 dps) (small n).

See Table.

Full tables for n \in \{3, 4, 5, 6, 9, 12\} — including q-deformed dimensions, signed content (chirality marker = 0), and depth-stratified groupings used by mass-tower computations — are in computations/wedderburn-strata-witness.json.
